destinations.name: Sikkim
destinations.overview: Monasteries, high lakes and Kanchenjunga views, a short drive up from the Darjeeling hills. Gangtok, Tsomgo Lake and Pelling are on the list for our first Sikkim departures. Dates and prices are still being planned.
